temperature.advice: High temperature detected. Apply fertilizers during early morning or late evening to reduce nutrient loss.
Low temperature may slow nutrient uptake. Avoid excessive fertilizer application.

humidity.advice: Very high humidity increases disease risk. Avoid excessive nitrogen fertilizers.
Low humidity can increase evaporation losses. Irrigate before fertilizer application.

rainfall.advice: Heavy rainfall expected. Delay fertilizer application to prevent nutrient leaching.
Moderate rainfall expected. Basal fertilizer application is suitable.
Very little rainfall expected. Irrigation after fertilizer application is recommended.

wind_speed.advice: Strong winds detected. Avoid foliar fertilizer spraying.
